articles.title: Group behind Revolut data breach demands $3 million in Monero, threaten to sell customer data
articles.snippet: The group gave Revolut 24 hours to pay and said it targeted customers with significant crypto holdings. Revolut said it has not not received any direct contact from the individuals.

articles.title: CFTC expands regulatory relief for passive trading software providers
articles.snippet: The US regulator’s move could make it easier for crypto wallets and other apps to offer access to regulated derivatives and prediction markets without registering as introducing brokers.

articles.title: OG.com cleared by SEC to offer single-stock futures, says Crypto.com CEO
articles.snippet: Crypto.com’s CEO said its sister exchange was cleared to offer US access to single-stock perpetual futures, as the latest platform to bridge TradFi and digital assets.

articles.title: Zcash gains 20% as Paradigm founder reveals firm made ZEC investment
articles.snippet: Zcash rose about 20% in 24 hours as Paradigm co-founder Matt Huang disclosed that the firm invested in ZEC amid a broader crypto market rally.

articles.title: Revolut says no direct contact from hackers after $3M public ransom demand
articles.snippet: Revolut says it received no direct contact despite separate ransom demands for $3 million in Monero and 10,000 Bitcoin from competing breach claimants.
